learning_objective: 🎯 We will enjoy a beautiful poem about nature, learn the colors of the rainbow, and understand the magic of rain and sunshine working together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the rain stops and the sun comes out, something magical happens in the sky. The light and water drops mix together.
A beautiful rainbow appears with seven bright colors. It looks like a colorful painting spread across the clouds.
The rainbow looks like a giant, colorful bridge connecting the earth to the sky. It reminds us of how beautiful nature can be.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Rainbow Handprints
fun_activity.instructions: Dip your fingers in different water colors and stamp them on paper to create your very own rainbow arch!

quick_recap: ⭐ Rainbows appear when sunlight shines through raindrops.
⭐ There are seven distinct colors that make up a rainbow.
⭐ The poem teaches us to appreciate the beautiful magic of nature.
